value.rationale: This natural class of alcoved zonotopes has an exponentially large vertex census, but its unique maximum-inscribed and minimum-enclosing volume ellipsoids admit an \(O(d)\)-candidate fully exact determination. The full contact spectrum has sharp parity-different initial phase limits; in \(d\ge4\) both circumsphere poles become noncontacts of the strictly better enclosing-volume ellipsoid. This is a substantial exact natural geometric invariant not a routine normalization/inradius result; later transitions remain algorithmically encoded without a one-line radical.
